responsibility: Declares the Rust frontend’s builtin attribute metadata and attribute-checking visitor. It defines the CompilerPass classification enum, the BuiltinAttrDefinition and singleton BuiltinAttributeMappings used to recognize reserved attribute names, and the AttributeChecker AST visitor interface that later verifies attribute placement and arguments across crate items.
same_name_distinction: Defines the attribute metadata structures, CompilerPass enum, singleton interface, and AttributeChecker visitor API; unlike gcc/rust/util/rust-attributes.cc, it does not hold the builtin attribute definition table or execute validation, only the types and declarations those checks are built on.
